title: picea omorika
intro: Picea omorika, commonly known as Serbian spruce, is a species of evergreen coniferous tree native to the Balkan Peninsula. The health benefits of Picea omorika include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health due to its rich content of essential oils. The therapeutic actions of Picea omorika include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, making it useful in treating respiratory issues and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Picea omorika include alpha-pinene, beta-pinene, and limonene, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
